summary: Spoke to Fadi. He gets enough work from Google and word of mouth and doesn't want a website right now.

transcript.said: Hi, this is FRIDAY, an AI assistant calling from your company. Am I speaking with the owner or manager of Fadi Plumbing?
Thanks Fadi. You've got great Google reviews but no website, so we built you a free demo. Can I send you the link?
Nah mate, I'm flat out from Google already. Not right now.
No problem at all. Thanks for your time, Fadi.
